ProgressIndicator.description:
A horizontal progress bar with a caption, exposed to assistive technology as `role="progressbar"`.
Atomic and display-only: numeric value/max, an enum tone and a boolean, all flat scalar props. Properties listed by Storybook metadata only; inherited HTML/DOM attributes and handlers are not part of this schema. Projected content (for example React children) may be missing from Storybook metadata and is not described here.

label.description: Accessible name and visible caption, e.g. "Dining out budget used".

showValue.description: Show the "value / max" readout next to the label.

value.description: Current amount. Values outside 0…max are clamped for display.
